name: Topaz
faction: Interastral Peace Corporation (Ten Stonehearts; leader of the Special Debts Picket Team)
description: Real name Jelena, Topaz is one of the IPC's Ten Stonehearts and leads the Special Debts Picket Team alongside her Warp Trotter companion, Numby. She specializes in debt collection and is known for her sharp business instincts.
